Markets.title: FPI selling crosses Rs 52,000 crore in October as Nifty defies foreign exodus
Markets.summary: Foreign portfolio investors withdrew over Rs 52,000 crore from Indian equities in October due to rising US Treasury yields and high crude oil prices. Despite this massive foreign exodus, benchmark indices rebounded sharply, driven by strong domestic institutional buying and gains in the IT sector.

Markets.title: Jefferies’ Chris Wood says it’s time to diversify beyond AI. Where should investors look now?
Markets.summary: Jefferies analyst Chris Wood advises investors to reduce exposure to artificial intelligence stocks due to slowing earnings growth and high valuations. Instead, he recommends allocating funds to markets in India, China, and other Asian regions, while selectively holding semiconductor stocks that avoid heavy AI spending.

Markets.title: FPIs pull out Rs 52,100 cr from equities in Oct so far amid global headwinds
Markets.summary: Foreign portfolio investors withdrew Rs 52,100 crore from Indian equities in October following a Rs 35,861 crore withdrawal in September. This financial retreat was driven by elevated crude oil prices, higher US bond yields, and a stronger dollar.

Markets.title: Mcap of nine of top-10 most valued firms surges by Rs 3.65 lakh cr; TCS shines
Markets.summary: Driven by a major rally in the BSE Sensex and Nifty, the combined market valuation of nine out of the top ten most valued firms surged by Rs 3.65 lakh crore last week. TCS, Bharti Airtel, and Infosys led these gains, while Larsen & Toubro was the only top firm to report a decline in valuation.

Markets.title: Bonus issues, stock splits & dividends: HDB Financial, IRFC, TechM among 19 stocks turning ex-record date this week
Markets.summary: Nineteen companies, including Tech Mahindra, IRFC, and HDB Financial Services, have set record dates this week for corporate actions like dividends, stock splits, and bonus issues. Investors must hold these shares in their demat accounts by the record date to qualify for the benefits.

Markets.title: LG Electronics, Polycab among picks as premiumisation and infrastructure demand drive growth: Siddhartha Khemka
Markets.summary: Siddhartha Khemka recommends LG Electronics and Polycab due to strong growth prospects driven by premiumisation and infrastructure demand. He sets target prices of Rs 2,075 for LG Electronics and Rs 10,600 for Polycab.

Geo-Political.title: Violent clashes, looting and buildings ablaze in France as more than 1,200 arrested after protests
Geo-Political.summary: More than half a million people participated in cost of living protests across France, leading to violent clashes and widespread looting. Police arrested over 1,200 individuals as buildings were set ablaze in cities nationwide.

Geo-Political.summary: Satellite images reveal a luxury boat equipped with a 50-meter pool and water slides near Kim Jong Un's summer retreat in North Korea. This lavish vessel highlights the extreme contrast between the North Korean leader's lifestyle and the poverty experienced by most citizens.

Geo-Political.summary: President Trump temporarily waived several recently passed congressional sanctions against Russia, citing national security. This decision coincides with an intensifying political conflict between the U.S. leader and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.

Data & Insights.title: 800 million jobs at risk over 15 years? World Bank's Ajay Banga calls for global financing overhaul
Data & Insights.summary: World Bank President Ajay Banga warned that 1.2 billion young people will enter the global workforce over the next decade, while only 400 million jobs are currently projected. To address this and other challenges, the institution plans to increase critical minerals financing to $19 billion by 2030 and mobilize additional private capital.

Data & Insights.title: PM-SETU: Five ITI clusters to get  ₹1,195 crore investment from Tata Steel Foundation, BVG India, others
Data & Insights.summary: Tata Steel Foundation, BVG India, and three other companies will invest to upgrade five ITI clusters under the PM-SETU scheme. This brings the cumulative approved investment under the scheme to ₹3,687 crore.

Data & Insights.title: Vibrant Goa summit to connect 220 Goan MSMEs with 300+ global buyers – What to expect?
Data & Insights.summary: The Government of Goa is hosting a three-day business summit from October 29 to 31 at the Dr Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Indoor Stadium. The event will connect 220 local MSMEs with over 300 global buyers and business leaders from more than 50 countries.

Data & Insights.title: ‘Most consequential change’: Kevin Warsh says AI will reshape US economy, warns of a ‘bumpy’ road ahead
Data & Insights.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh stated that artificial intelligence will boost long-term productivity while potentially increasing inflation in the short term. He warned that economic transitions driven by this technology and emerging markets will likely be bumpy and uncertain.

India.title: UGC NET December 2026: Check Revised Exam Dates, Admit Card Details, Test Rules
India.summary: Ball-point pens will be provided to candidates at the examination centre for the UGC NET December 2026 exam. The exam-conducting body released this information alongside updates regarding revised exam dates and admit card details.

India.title: Schemes, Chit Funds, Returns: Kingpin Of Multistate Investment Scam Arrested In Telangana
India.summary: Police in Telangana arrested the kingpin of a multistate investment and chit fund scam. Preliminary questioning in Adilabad district revealed about Rs 7 crore to Rs 8 crore in transactions involving nearly 2,000 members.

India.title: Actor Pawan Singh Fined Rs 3,000 For Skipping Hearing In Wife's Maintenance Case
India.summary: Bhojpuri actor Pawan Singh was fined Rs 3,000 for failing to attend a court hearing regarding his wife's maintenance case. His lawyer submitted a medical certificate stating his mother was unwell, along with an application for mediation.

India.title: Posed As Cops, Changed Vehicles: Gang Kidnaps Jeweller, Extorts Rs 1.3 Crore
India.summary: A criminal gang disguised as police officers kidnapped a jeweller near the Golnaka flyover on October 5 and blindfolded him. The kidnappers held him at an undisclosed location and extorted Rs 1.3 crore from him.

India.title: Chief Justice To Inaugurate Permanent High Court Bench In Leh Today
India.summary: The Chief Justice of India is inaugurating a permanent High Court bench in Leh today. Ladakh Chief Secretary Ashish Kundra stated that this development will bring justice closer to the residents of the Union Territory.

India.title: Organisers Among 7 Arrested For Kolkata Durga Puja Stampede That Killed 19
India.summary: Seven people, including festival organisers, were arrested following a stampede at the Chorbagan Durga Puja in Kolkata. The incident occurred during heavy rain and resulted in 19 deaths.

General.title: Violent clashes, looting and buildings ablaze in France as more than 1,200 arrested after protests
General.summary: Violent clashes, looting, and fires broke out across France during cost-of-living protests attended by more than half a million people. Authorities arrested over 1,200 individuals in connection with the widespread disorder.

General.title: Watch: Moment historic French town hall spire collapses in flames amid protests
General.summary: A historic town hall spire in Limoges, France, collapsed in flames after being set on fire during national protests. The incident occurred in the southern city as demonstrations swept across the country.
